Hello team,

We need sharper handling at the counter today, so please read carefully and act without delay. boarding closes after 68 hours, and every file tied to that step must be complete before it reaches review. Keep the language clear with travelers and log each action in the desk ledger as soon as it is done.

For check-in, use FM-286 and confirm that the form is attached before you move the file forward. transfer is controlled by Records Curator, so send only complete cases and flag any missing item at once. If a traveler such as Layla Williams or Andre Ibrahim arrives with a companion animal like Ellie, make sure the notes match the paperwork before the record leaves our queue.

Training Editor Companion Animal Travel Desk
